model.backbone: torchvision ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18, frozen, fc replaced by identity

response.definition: first 9 coordinates of per-anchor mean-centered 10-class logits
response.reason_for_nine: the 10 centered logits have one exact linear dependence

audit.node_convention: J_t is evaluated at the pre-step parameter vector; delta_t is the complete post-step minus pre-step AdamW update including weight decay and optimizer state
audit.random_directions: deterministic ambient Gaussian directions rescaled to the realized update norm; identical directions evaluated under current and source Jacobians
audit.time_shuffle: circular shift by +1 over audited realized updates, evaluated under each unshifted node Jacobian

hard_limit_enforcement: launcher kills the audit subprocess at 3300 seconds; in-engine checks occur between adaptation steps
primary_non_tautological_metric: raw AdamW update response leakage under current Jacobian versus the same raw update under the frozen source Jacobian
report_only_spectral_control: (current update/current random median)/(source update/source random median); frozen before outcomes, no positivity threshold
claim_boundary: Tests whether ordinary AdamW updates preferentially follow the current rather than source-fixed declared response geometry in one frozen-backbone ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 construction. It is not a proof for SGD, full-backbone training, arbitrary optimizers, complete kernels, semantic invariance, or a global variational law.
